title: Require Recipe Metrics Study Structure
forbids: recipe metrics capability roots outside the closed measurement, target, policy, and study-bank topology
why: Metrics are an optional recipe capability, but every recipe that carries a metrics root has one closed system of scenario admission, capture, neutral families, benchmark targets, optional product policy, executable studies, family sheets, and benchmark one-pagers. Named nested family modules preserve semantic hierarchy without opening a generic support cabinet.
remediate: Keep the canonical scenario, capture, sample, family, target, optional policy, and structured study-bank surfaces beneath the recipe metrics root; move every other concern to its actual recipe, domain, SDK, diagnostics, or documentation owner.
message: Recipe metrics capability roots must match the closed positive metrics study topology.
